key_insight: Ms-LegONet learns reusable coefficient-dependent local spaces, then composes them into continuous multiscale finite element solutions with localized error bounds.
engineering_relevance: For heterogeneous elliptic simulations, the method supports changes in material layout, loading, boundary conditions and domain size without retraining within the trained coefficient class.
method: Train one network per spatial dimension on local coefficient patches and patch-level harmonic responses, with no global training solves.
Predict zero-boundary spaces and compute multiscale basis functions through Galerkin harmonic extensions with shared interface traces.
Assemble larger blocks by recursive static condensation and attribute error primitive by primitive using a localized Céa bound.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports 4–150× lower L2 error than baselines at equal unknowns on 2D mosaics of 256 high-contrast primitives, plus 30–900× faster many-query 3D chain port responses at 10⁻⁴ relative error.
watch_item: Reuse is restricted to the trained coefficient class, and inference still requires local Galerkin solves and multiscale assembly.
paper_title: Multiscale LegONet: Learning Coefficient-Dependent Local Spaces for Composable Multiscale Finite Elements with Localized Error Bounds
